# v1.3 — UX review fixes: input validation, Bing junk guard, docs

Third-party-perspective UX review (`docs/ux-review-2026-11-07.md`) found
2 P0, 3 P1, and 6 P2 issues. All are fixed in this release.

## Fixed — P0

- **Unknown flags silently became search terms** (`--help` searched the
  Cambridge Dictionary). `search.mjs` now validates flags: unknown options
  and missing values exit 2 with the usage line; `--help`/`-h` prints full
  help (engines, options, doctor pointer). Python argparse already behaved.
- **Python/urllib path: Bing degraded to serving unrelated results** instead
  of failing (observed: "webgpu" → Google homepage / Baidu baike) while the
  same query on the same machine returned correct results via Node. Both
  runtimes now run a bot-junk guard on Bing results — same-domain SERPs,
  homepage-only SERPs, and latin queries with zero word overlap fail soft as
  `bot junk detected` so cooldown + other engines take over. Bing requests
  also send `Referer`/`Upgrade-Insecure-Requests`. Detector unit-tested with
  synthetic junk and live non-junk (4/4 node, 4/4 python).

## Fixed — P1

- Text mode: the engines status block moved to **stdout** — piped output
  (`| head`) no longer interleaves results and engine status.
- Unknown engine names (`--engine duckduckgo`) now error with the **full
  valid engine list** instead of a generic "no engines available".
- Failure cooldown is now **documented and visible**: README/README.zh-CN
  gained a Troubleshooting section (state file location, reset, bypasses);
  doctor shows `[cooldown: <reason>]` per engine, reports the state file in
  JSON, and gained a `--clear-cooldown` flag (node + python).

## Fixed — P2

- `--days` on Bing no longer silently ignored: engine status shows
  `[days ignored by bing]` (JSON includes a `note` field).
- `fetch` failure messages explain the tool targets HTML pages (read
  JSON/text endpoints directly).
- `fetch` strips footer/boilerplate `<div>`s matched by
  footer/copyright/icp/beian id/class (runoob 备案 block gone).
- SKILL.md surfaces `--lang` up front; README/README.zh-CN document that
  re-running the add command updates in place, add a post-install `doctor`
  verification step, and use the real repo URL instead of `<you>`.

## Testing

- e2e: 24 checks passing on the node side (+4 python-twin checks where
  python3 exists), including new cases for `--help`, unknown flags, engine
  name errors, days note, and the junk detector.

## Compatibility

- CLI interface unchanged; `--help`/-h added; unknown flags now error
  (previously misinterpreted as query terms — that was the bug).
- Default behavior unchanged; the junk guard can fail the Bing engine soft
  (by design, covered by other engines + cooldown).
